name: Limited meal/entertainment tax classification reference

sections: Exception to the 50% Limit for Meals

assumptions: This is a narrow reference, not a complete determination of deductibility or a production tax rule pack.
Other exceptions and missing qualification facts require review. Not applicable means outside these encoded checks, not tax-exempt or deductible.
Qualified employee recreation requires independent evidence; merely calling something a company event is insufficient.
The 60-day accountable-plan substantiation period is a safe harbor. The strict deadline in the company pack is a demo company policy.
Synthetic meals_50, meals_100 and entertainment_0 are routing labels, not account IDs from the source dataset.

rules.text: Qualifying ordinary business meals without an applicable exception use the 50%-limited meal classification.

fix.description: Verify meal qualifications and route to the demo 50%-limited meal classification.

rules.text: Qualifying employee recreational meal expenses use the meal classification outside the 50% limitation.

fix.description: Verify the employee-recreation exception before changing the classification.

rules.text: Entertainment expenses with no applicable exception use the nondeductible entertainment classification.

fix.description: Route to the demo nondeductible entertainment classification. This does not determine company purchase permission.
